g.aria-label: Non-Adaptive Grid (√(log k / n)) vs. Adaptive Leaderboard Attack (√(k / n))
(a) Non-Adaptive Pre-Registered Pool: Fix All k Models BEFORE Seeing Scores
f₁,...,f_k chosen independent of holdout S ⇒ Max gap ≤ √(log(2k/δ)/(2n))
(b) Adaptive Blum–Hardt Attack: Inspect Holdout Score After Each Query
Submit k random coin-flip vectors → keep those with error ≤ ½ → majority vote
Holdout error drops to ½ − Ω(√(k/n)) while population error stays 50%!
